takes.note: A stands on the west key in the sentry's sights and is shot on the downbeat of bar 4 (local second six). Her ghost walks on through the live lasers, breaks the booth wall on beat 20 (second ten) and throws the switch on beat 24 (second twelve). None of it counts yet.

plan.note: dead by now (bolt lands at beat 12.1); the ghost sets off

takes.note: B stands on the east key: both keys are down from beat 4, so the gate opens. B is nearer to the sentry than A, so in this take the bolt is B's, and A walks into the lasers alive instead.

C waits at the gate, slips in behind the sentry and cuts it down long before its shot on beat 11, then stands on the mute pad. Nobody is shot, the lasers are off when A reaches them, and everything A's ghost did becomes real.

notes: Objective complete at beat 24: Throw the ON AIR switch.
Survivors: Tape A, Tape B, Tape C.
